warnings: the list ends with the final DROP, so from the paste on only the addresses it permits reach the unit and --from was not given: check that the address you are logged in from is permitted before you paste (--from <address> makes tacctl check)
the pull saw 1 other session on the unit: the paste is live for them too; type /SN before you paste and make sure no other administrator is working on it

Step 1 changes what the unit asks of the TACACS+ server or how it answers when the server fails: a wrong secret word, host, port or service name does not stop a login, it returns every login to the unit's Default User Access level, and Fallback Local decides whether the unit's own accounts work when the server does not answer; keep the serial session open and do the check after the ESC step before anything else
